newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's CEOE warn against differing regional taxes.
newsitem.headline: Spain's CEOE warn against differing regional taxes.

text.p: Spanish employers' organisation CEOE called for a reduction in corporate tax rates and warned that a system of differing regional rates could prove dangerous for the economy, local press reported on Tuesday.

"It is necessary to rule out distinctions. If it is possible to reduce tax rates in one region, it should be possible doing the same also in the other," said CEOE vicepresident Arturo Gil, according to a report in newspaper Gaceta de los Negocios.
On Monday, the Navarre region announced a reduction in tax on companies operating in the area from 35 percent to 32.5.
